slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to maximize the total profit from the manufactured toys, or is there a different objective such as minimizing resource usage or meeting a specific production target?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to maximize total profit, fully covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: boat_not_exceed_train
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about truck/train and boat/airplane logic and minimum production, but never inquired about any constraint linking boats to trains; the READY_TO_MODEL model simply omits such a rule.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no constraint linking the number of boats to the number of trains (i.e., boats need not be less than or equal to trains).
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a boat-train restriction, yet its confirmed-understanding model lists only truck/train and boat/airplane logic, implicitly assuming no boat-train relationship exists.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The single P0 slot (objective) was resolved before READY_TO_MODEL, and the only remaining unresolved slot (H2) is P2, so stopping was appropriate.

summary: The agent cleanly recovered the P0 objective slot and other key structure via targeted questions, but never probed the boat-vs-train constraint (H2, P2), silently omitting it from its model. Overall interaction quality is good.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
